label: TP
reason: User-supplied cookie value flows through URL decoding, Base64 encode/decode roundtrip, then into HTML context via ESAPI encoder which does not neutralize script tags. The resulting string contains unescaped characters that can lead to reflected XSS.

evidence.note: User cookie value read and decoded
Round-trip Base64 decode/encode preserves content including potential scripts
Unencoded user data written directly into HTML response
